elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires HDI to provide reasonable transition assistance at the Company's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(a) specifies a period of up to six (6) months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(a) expressly states that assistance will be provided at HDI's then-current rates.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires HDI to return to the Company all Content, user information, customer and order data, and other Company data in HDI's possession or control.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires return within thirty (30) days of the Termination Date.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires a commonly used, machine-readable format, which satisfies the standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor deletes it from its systems.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(c) requires HDI thereafter to delete the returned Content and data from its systems.

elements.element: After deletion, Vendor certifies deletion to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(c) requires HDI to certify the deletion to the Company in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires HDI to provide reasonable transition assistance at the Company's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The assistance period may extend up to six (6) months, encompassing the required 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor exports Customer Data for Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires HDI to return the Company's Content and data to the Company.

elements.element: Vendor completes the data export within 30 days.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires return within thirty (30) days of the Termination Date.

result.reason: The redline substantively reaches the preferred position and therefore also the fallback. It adds only exit-related assistance, migration cooperation, data return, deletion, and certification terms without altering unrelated commercial provisions. Drafting quality is reduced because the 30-day deadline is tied to the defined “Termination Date,” which is expressly generated by a particular termination notice and may be unclear for an expiration or another termination route, even though Section 4.3's introductory trigger broadly covers expiration or termination for any reason.
